message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you sell your acoustic guitar quickly and safely, whether you’re aiming for a local sale or an online listing.

---

## 1. Prepare Your Guitar

| Task | Why It Matters | Quick Tips |
|------|----------------|------------|
| **Clean & Tune** | A well‑maintained instrument looks more appealing and fetches a higher price. | Use a soft cloth, guitar polish, and a tuner. |
| **Check for Damage** | Hidden cracks or loose hardware can reduce value. | Inspect the neck, body, bridge, and strings. |
| **Take High‑Quality Photos** | Good visuals attract buyers. | Use natural light, shoot from multiple angles (front, back, side, close‑up of fretboard, hardware). |
| **Document Serial Number** | Helps verify authenticity and condition. | Write it down and include it in your listing. |

---

## 2. Determine a Fair Price

| Method | How to Use It |
|--------|---------------|
| **Online Marketplaces** | Search “acoustic guitar” + brand + model on Reverb, eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace. |
| **Price Guides** | Check sites like Guitar Center, Sweetwater, or local classifieds for similar listings. |
| **Professional Appraisal** | If it’s a vintage or high‑end model, consider a quick appraisal from a local shop. |
| **Set a Slightly Higher Asking Price** | Gives you room to negotiate while still staying competitive. |

---

## 3. Choose Where to Sell

| Platform | Best For | Pros | Cons |
|----------|----------|------|------|
| **Reverb** | Musicians, gear enthusiasts | Dedicated audience, built‑in payment & shipping tools | Fees (~10% + payment processing) |
| **eBay** | General marketplace | Auction or fixed price, large reach | Fees, potential for buyer disputes |
| **Craigslist / Facebook Marketplace** | Local sales | No shipping, instant pickup | Safety concerns, less buyer protection |
| **Local Music Stores** | Trade‑in or consignment | Quick sale, professional handling | May offer lower price or take a commission |
| **Etsy** | Vintage or handmade instruments | Niche audience | Fees, limited to certain categories |

---

## 4. Create a Compelling Listing

1. **Title** – Include brand, model, year, and key features (e.g., “Fender CD-60 Acoustic Guitar, 2015, Excellent Condition”).
2. **Description** – Cover:
   - Brand & model
   - Year of manufacture
   - Condition (new, like new, used, minor wear)
   - Any upgrades or modifications
   - Included accessories (case, strap, picks)
   - Reason for selling
3. **Photos** – Add at least 5–7 images: overall view, close‑ups of fretboard, bridge, hardware, serial number, and any imperfections.
4. **Price** – State your asking price and whether it’s negotiable.
5. **Shipping** – Offer local pickup, shipping (include cost or “free shipping”), or both.
6. **Payment Methods** – Specify accepted payments (PayPal, Venmo, cash, bank transfer).

---

## 5. Handle the Sale Safely

| Step | Tips |
|------|------|
| **Meet in a Public Place** | For local sales, choose a police station, coffee shop, or a busy mall. |
| **Bring a Friend** | Adds safety and a second set of eyes. |
| **Verify Payment** | For online sales, wait until the payment is confirmed before handing over the guitar. |
| **Use a Shipping Service** | If shipping, use a reputable carrier (UPS, FedEx, USPS) with tracking and insurance. |
| **Get a Receipt** | Provide a simple receipt or confirmation email. |
| **Keep Records** | Save all communication, invoices, and shipping receipts. |

---

## 6. Final Checklist

- [ ] Clean and tune the guitar
- [ ] Take professional photos
- [ ] Research comparable listings
- [ ] Set a realistic asking price
- [ ] Choose the right platform(s)
- [ ] Draft a clear, honest description
- [ ] Decide on shipping or local pickup
- [ ] Prepare for safe transaction

---

### Quick Resources

| Resource | Link |
|----------|------|
| Reverb | https://reverb.com |
| eBay | https://www.ebay.com |
| Craigslist | https://craigslist.org |
| Facebook Marketplace | https://facebook.com/marketplace |
| Guitar Center | https://www.guitarcenter.com |
| Sweetwater | https://www.sweetwater.com |

Good luck with your sale! If you need help drafting a listing or choosing a platform, just let me know.
